title: WikiWatchTriggeredPayload
description: wiki.watch.triggered v1 (OpenVibe.Wiki server/wiki/service.js notifyWatchers). One event per change to a watched page, listing the watchers who may read the page (never the actor); not emitted when nobody is left. Envelope: subject { type: page, id: pg_…, revision: <revision or 0> }, visibility internal, priority important, actor the person or service.

action.description: revised = a new draft revision; proposed = an AI proposal awaits approval; the rest follow wiki.page.*.
